determinism_rules: Where G3 stated a range or dependency, the per-characteristic evidence file supplies the explicit capability facts that select ONE outcome.
popular_custom/runcomfy=low: auto-setup supported and exact pin not required for this characteristic.
popular_custom/comfy_cloud=low: supplied allowlist evidence places the fixture node on the curated list (off-list branch documented as high).
native_build_dependency/runcomfy=unknown: audited UNKNOWN capability; emit target_capability_unknown, never assume support/failure.
native_build_dependency/baseten=medium: verified setup path exists (lower bound of the audited medium-high range with verified setup path).
private_model/comfy_cloud=high: supplied catalog-miss evidence (catalog-hit branch documented as low).
absolute_path/local=low: self-consistent host path; all remote targets high via severity override.
